releaseNotes:
v2.23.0 — 500 levels per difficulty with 50 unique zone themes
• Easy, Regular and Hard modes each expanded to 500 levels
• 480 unique words per standard difficulty before any cycling
• 50 new zone themes across 5 worlds (500 levels total)
• Zone themes: Beginnings, Wild Frontiers, Ancient Wonders, Elemental Realms, Legendary Endgame
• Android level select now shows up to 500 levels (was 100)
• All new words include verified definitions shown on win screen
